items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-11-01
items.q: That was my cousin he was in tomato business with.

ctx.x: Oh, no, no. The only time I had a problem, there was a guy who got money from the Marcellos to start a record company. And I was on the big studio on Governor Nichols, 521. And he did some sessions and all that. Nothing came of him.
But he also spent a lot. He bought himself a car and he had a girlfriend and all that with their money.
